legend: Allyn is playing a new strategy game called "Accumulator Apex". In this game, Allyn is given the initial value of an integer x%%ZSMJ0%%, referred to as the accumulator, and k%%ZSMJ1%% lists of integers. Allyn can make multiple turns. On each turn, Allyn can withdraw the leftmost element from any non-empty list and add it to the accumulator x%%ZSMJ2%% if the resulting x%%ZSMJ3%% is non-negative. Allyn can end the game at any moment. The goal of the game is to get the largest possible value of the accumulator x%%ZSMJ4%%. Please help Allyn find the largest possible value of the accumulator x%%ZSMJ5%% they can get in this game.
input: The first line of the input contains two integers x%%ZSMJ6%% and k%%ZSMJ7%% (0≤x≤109,1≤k≤105%%ZSMJ8%%) — the initial value of the accumulator x%%ZSMJ9%% and the number of lists. The next k%%ZSMJ10%% lines contain the description of lists: an integer li%%ZSMJ11%% (li≥1%%ZSMJ12%%) followed on the same line by li%%ZSMJ13%% elements of the list in the order from left to right. Each element of lists does not exceed 109%%ZSMJ14%% by the absolute value, and the total size of all lists does not exceed 105%%ZSMJ15%%.
output: The sole line of the output should contain the largest value of the accumulator x%%ZSMJ16%% Allyn can get.
note: In the first input, we start with x=1%%ZSMJ17%%. Then, we can take the first integer from the first list and get x=0%%ZSMJ18%% — adding the next integer 2%%ZSMJ19%% from the first list we get x=2%%ZSMJ20%%. After that, we can add the integers from the second list and obtain x=3%%ZSMJ21%%. Finally, we can add the integers from the third list and obtain x=4%%ZSMJ22%%.

In the second input, we can add the first integer from the second list and get x=2%%ZSMJ23%%. Then, by adding the elements from the first list, we get x=4%%ZSMJ24%%. We cannot add more integers to increase x%%ZSMJ25%%.
